title: Twists preserve finiteness conditions
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, an integer $n\geq1$, and a scheme $S$ on which $\ell$ is invertible. Put $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$. Use the twists $\Lambda(m)$ and $K(m)$ of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], for $m\in\mathbf Z$ and $\Lambda\in\{A_{E,n},\mathcal O_E,E,\Qlb\}$.

At finite coefficients, $A_{E,n}(m)$ is an invertible locally constant rank-one sheaf of $(A_{E,n})_S$-modules. At integral coefficients, $\mathcal O_E(m)$ is an invertible locally free rank-one module over the completed coefficient sheaf $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,S}$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], with finite-level reductions $A_{E,j}(m)$ for every $j\geq1$. Here invertible means that tensoring with its sheaf dual gives the coefficient sheaf; locally free of rank one means isomorphic to that coefficient sheaf on a covering of the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. At $E$ and $\Qlb$, invertibility means invertibility of the images of these lines in the rationalized category [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] and its common-finite-stage coefficient category [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], respectively.

For every displayed coefficient, twisting preserves $D^b_c(S,\Lambda)$ and $D^b_{ctf}(S,\Lambda)$ [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility, def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. At finite coefficients it preserves the cohomological vanishing interval and every Tor-amplitude interval $[a,b]$. At integral coefficients it preserves the single cohomological interval and the single Tor-amplitude interval valid for all derived reductions, and preserves derived completeness. The inverse twist is $(-)(-m)$. The $E$ and $\Qlb$ assertions are interpreted on integral representatives and at common finite stages, as in the coefficient definitions; no ambient category of arbitrary discrete $E$- or $\Qlb$-module sheaves is asserted.

proof.text: Apply signedLineTensor_equivalence to the finite first line and to the completed integral first line. These give rank one for every signed power and the inverse sheaf tensor isomorphisms. Descend those isomorphisms by mapDerivedCategoryCompIso, mapDerivedCategoryNatIso and mapDerivedCategoryIdIso to obtain the two inverse derived twist formulas.

Apply finiteLineTensor_conditions. The exact-functor homology comparison identifies each homology sheaf of the twist with the tensor of the original homology sheaf. Hence the support shrinks, and the same constructible cohomology range works. Tensor preserves each constructible sheaf by the interface. Combining this with the unchanged Tor interval gives finiteTorConstructible. Transport of constructibility across isomorphisms is proved by pulling the isomorphism to each stratum and each geometric stalk; constantComparison_isIso supplies the actual constant-coefficient pullback functor.

Use signedTwistReduction_comparison for the unique canonical maps, the single-object reductions and the natural isomorphism between reduction after twisting and finite twisting after reduction. Apply integralLineTensor_complete to the exact completed line tensor. Transport the finite support, Tor and constructibility statements through each component of the natural isomorphism, retaining the same common intervals for every reduction. These are precisely the conjuncts of sfIntegralConstructible and finiteTorConstructibleIntegral. The twisting-object membership is the existing sfIntegralTwistingObject_mem theorem.

The final two conjuncts are fieldTwist_inverse, with the recorded rational and common-stage functors exactly as stated. Assemble these with the preceding finite and integral clauses to obtain the unchanged proposition.

reviewed_lean.note: Read the item, the 8 statement dependencies, the source place, report.md (it has Worker report and Second reading by Q115 sections) and both modules. Integral clauses: completed line, uniquely normalized reductions, D^b_c, completeness, D^b_ctf, uniform intervals, membership of O_E(m). Inverse twists at all four coefficients. The only Lean change since the passed head 23f6d5 drops the finiteTorConstructible premise from the finite Tor clause. That is a true strengthening: HasProEtaleTorAmplitude is defined for any K and is preserved by an exact invertible tensor. Gates pass: no hollow definitions, docstrings and 13-step proof plan present, only sorry, ProEt site used, universes u and v only, statements verbatim. That drops the retained Q118 and Q151 interfaces. Fixed: fixes/IntrinsicCoefficientTwistsUnrestricted.lean adds public import Sheaf.Paper.PbcCoefficientTwists.
